The console on the right has a matte finish and a PlayStation logo on the top surface.
The console on the left has a glossy finish and a different design with a vertical slot.
Both units show significant surface scratches and wear.
The background shows retail shelves with various phone and tablet boxes.

No controller is visible in either photo.

risks.proof: A video of the console running a game or the system menu.
